name: tifa-bundle-testdata
description: npm packages the internal/bundle tests bundle: React for the trimmed renderer, seroval and core-js for the adapters, @emotion/hash for the hash in Go, i18next for its translations, lucide-react for the cache of its icons, react-i18next for the copy of its i18n object, @radix-ui/react-slot for the merge of its props, the other SSR host patches, and Vite with the React plugin, which build them.
